name: The Defias Brotherhood
summary: In Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood's troubles reach Stormwind. Gryan Stoutmantle sends you to deliver Wiley's Note to Master Mathias Shaw, suspecting a link between the Defias and the old Stonemasons Guild.

sections.title: A Slip of the Tongue
sections.body: A mention of the Stonemasons in Wiley's communications catches Gryan Stoutmantle's attention. The builders rebuilt Stormwind City after the First War, but the guild has long been thought scattered or dissolved. If the Defias Brotherhood shares ties with them, Westfall's rural insurgency is more than a disorganized band of outlaws.

sections.title: Old Town Secrets
sections.body: From Sentinel Hill, Gryan Stoutmantle cannot confirm his suspicions. He sends you to Master Mathias Shaw, head of Stormwind's covert intelligence wing, SI:7. Shaw works from the Barracks in Old Town, gathering whispers and secrets from across the realm. He may be able to untangle the Defias Brotherhood's origins.

sections.title: The Shadow Over the Crown
sections.body: Wiley's Note brings Master Mathias Shaw a grave concern: the rebellion in Westfall runs deeper and carries more political complexity than Gryan Stoutmantle understands. Shaw points to Stormwind's own turbulent past.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle send you to Stormwind?
faq.answer: A mention of the Stonemasons in Wiley's Note makes Gryan Stoutmantle suspect political intrigue behind the banditry. He sends you to Master Mathias Shaw to confirm the connection.
Master Mathias Shaw leads SI:7, Stormwind's covert intelligence and espionage branch. He works from the Barracks in Old Town.

faq.q: Where do I find Mathias Shaw?
faq.answer: You find Master Mathias Shaw on the second floor of the SI:7 headquarters in the Barracks of Old Town, Stormwind City.

faq.q: What is the connection between the Defias and the Stonemasons?
faq.answer: The Stonemasons Guild rebuilt Stormwind after its destruction in the First War. Gryan Stoutmantle suspects Wiley's mention of the guild links it to the Defias, and Mathias Shaw can confirm or deny the connection.

Wiley's Note is from Wiley the Black, a scoundrel Gryan Stoutmantle has dealt with before. It warns that the Defias are plotting with gnolls, kobolds, and goblins, and Wiley's mention of the Stonemasons may link the Defias Brotherhood to the former guild.

faq.q: Does Highlord Bolvar or the boy-king know about this?
faq.answer: Covert state matters pass through Mathias Shaw and SI:7 before reaching Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the throne. Shaw says the matter may be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.

angles.text: At SI:7 headquarters, you meet Mathias Shaw, grandmaster of Stormwind's rogues and spies. His work connects Westfall's local turmoil to wider tradecraft.
As a human of Stormwind, you see Westfall's lawless frontier meet the bitter, unresolved political scandals that followed the rebuilding of your capital.
As an Alliance member, you see fractures within the Alliance's primary kingdom. Some threats come from betrayed citizens, not monstrous outsiders.
